01 / The partnership opportunity

Get your brand
into the conversation.

Partner with Top Choice Lending across three activations designed to bring brands and prospective buyers together through culture, hospitality and personal connection.

Led by Ken Gilliard, President of Top Choice Lending, this partnership offers a way to introduce your business in a setting built for interaction.

From the first brand impression to an in-person conversation and a voluntary follow-up, partners can create a clear path for interested guests to learn more about their products or services.

The opportunity can be tailored to a single activation or a presence across all three, depending on your goals, budget and the agreed scope.

02 / What your partnership can deliver

Visibility that opens
the door to connection.

01 / BRAND PRESENCE

Be seen.

Introduce your brand through agreed activation signage, digital promotion and partner recognition. A presence across three touchpoints creates multiple opportunities for discovery.

02 / BUYER ENGAGEMENT

Start a conversation.

Bring your offering to life through a product showcase, demonstration, sampling or a useful guest experience that gives prospective buyers a reason to engage.

03 / FOLLOW-UP

Build the next step.

Use an approved QR code, dedicated offer or opt-in inquiry form to help interested guests connect directly with your team after the activation.
